This Writ Petition has been filed to direct the 1 st respondent to pay interest on the alleged delay in payment of the compensation to the petitioner in respect of the lands acquired from the petitioner based on his representation dated 12.01.2026 within a time frame fixed by this Court.

2.Earlier, the petitioner had challenged the deduction of 1/3rd from the compensation amount determined by the respondents on account of development charges before this Court by filing a Writ Petition in W.P.No.35735 of 2024.

By the order dated 25.11.2024, the said Writ Petition __________ Page2 of 6 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 06/03/2026 06:14:10 pm ) came to be allowed and the deduction of 1/3rd towards development charges was quashed by this Court.
In view of the same, the petitioner was also paid the 1/3rd deducted amount.

However,
according to the petitioner, there was a delay on the part of the respondents to pay the entire compensation amount.

The petitioner seeks for payment of interest for the delayed payment at the rate of 9% per annum for the first year till 19.06.2025 and thereafter, at the rate of 15% per annum till 14.08.2025 as per the provisions of Section 72 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the RFCTLARR Act for the sake of convenience).

The petitioner had given a representation for the aforesaid purposes on 12.01.2026 to the respondents.
Since the same has not been considered, the petitioner has filed the present Writ Petition.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This Writ Petition has been filed to direct the 1 st respondent to pay interest on the alleged delay in payment of the compensation to the petitioner in respect of the lands acquired from the petitioner based on his representation dated 12.01.2026 within a time frame fixed by this Court.
The petitioner seeks for payment of interest for the delayed payment at the rate of 9% per annum for the first year till 19.06.2025 and thereafter, at the rate of 15% per annum till 14.08.2025 as per the provisions of Section 72 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the RFCTLARR Act for the sake of convenience).
The petitioner had given a representation for the aforesaid purposes on 12.01.2026 to the respondents.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The petitioner also seeks for payment of interest on the compensation amount paid towards arithmetical error in determining the compensation at the rate of 9% per annum for the first year till 19.06.2025 and thereafter, at the rate of 15% per annum till 10.11.2025.
Since the same has not been considered, the petitioner has filed the present Writ Petition.
No prejudice would be caused to the respondents if the petitioners representation dated 12.01.2026 is considered in accordance with law within the time frame to be fixed by this Court.
For the foregoing reasons, this Writ Petition is disposed of by directing the 1st respondent to pass final orders on merits and in accordance with law on the petitioners representation dated 12.01.2026 seeking for payment of interest for the alleged delay in payment of the entire compensation amount to the petitioner in respect of the lands acquired from him which is the subject matter of this Writ Petition within a period of twelve weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
